verdict.rationale: An agent can drive several compliance-type filings through documented API endpoints: tax registration, where an ELSTER XML is generated and sent to the tax office, plus trade registration, with status polling and webhooks for hands-off progress. The platform also says it handles post-incorporation filings such as the Transparenzregister entry, and an agent-readable llms.txt exists. However, these are one-off registrations rather than recurring annual reports, and the Compliance API is Enterprise-only with no documented scope. missing for 10: evidence of annual report or recurring compliance filing support, documented Compliance API capabilities beyond plan gating, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven filing.
